Poly Haven assets licence

All assets on Poly Haven are licensed as CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication):
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

You may use them for any purpose, commercial or not, without attribution, and redistribute and modify
them. Who Did It credits Poly Haven anyway (CREDITS.md, "Poly Haven material library").

Public API terms (https://github.com/Poly-Haven/Public-API/blob/master/ToS.md, read 2026-10-23): free
for any purpose; requests carry a user agent naming the app (`who-did-it-build`); an in-app credit is asked
of apps that surface the live API, which the game never does (assets are fetched once, at build time).
